content.content: Please create a new 1 hour long event 'Follow-up meeting' on 2024-05-19 at 10:00 or 16:00 if at 10:00 I already have something. The description should be 'Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.'. The event should have the same participants as 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15.

```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Get the current day
current_day = get_current_day()

# Search for the event 'Introductory meeting' on 2024-05-15
events = search_calendar_events(query="Introductory meeting", date="2024-05-15")

# Check if the event exists
if not events:
    raise ValueError("Event 'Introductory meeting' on 2024-05-15 not found")

# Get the participants of the 'Introductory meeting' event
participants = events[0].participants

# Define the start and end times for the new event
start_time_1 = datetime.strptime("2024-05-19 10:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_time_1 = start_time_1 + timedelta(hours=1)

start_time_2 = datetime.strptime("2024-05-19 16:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_time_2 = start_time_2 + timedelta(hours=1)

# Check if the time slot at 10:00 is available
events_at_10 = search_calendar_events(query="", date="2024-05-19")
events_at_10 = [event for event in events_at_10 if event.start_time == start_time_1 and event.end_time == end_time_1]

if events_at_10:
    # If the time slot at 10:00 is not available, use the time slot at 16:00
    start_time = start_time_2
    end_time = end_time_2
else:
    # If the time slot at 10:00 is available, use it
    start_time = start_time_1
    end_time = end_time_1

# Create the new event
create_calendar_event(title="Follow-up meeting", start_time=start_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), end_time=end_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.", participants=participants, location=None)
```
